initial_findings: All assigned numerical exercises already had answers, including early stopping, mixed spending, infinite PMF, unusual dice and lottery.
The PMF formula as a sum of singleton sample-outcome probabilities was overgeneralized; a discrete variable can be defined on an uncountable sample space.
The unusual-dice sample space was described but not fully constructed as the question requested.
The source’s set-based CDF proofs and square-distance derivative/sector steps were compressed or absent, despite the final formulas being correct.
changes: Corrected PMF definition with preimage-event formulation and a continuous-sample-space counterexample; explicitly stated support, bounds and interval sums.
Added the unusual-dice 36-outcome sample space and full sum grid, retaining repeated physical faces.
Added CDF set proofs, one-sided limits, no-atoms/continuity relationship and strict versus non-strict tail identities.
Added source-style triangle/sector area calculation, full square-distance chain/product-rule differentiation and boundary checks.
Added source’s count and future-index examples with historical-quote caveat.
remaining_limitations: The early-stopping slide does not specify whether a baseline epoch is counted; the lesson explicitly gives N as recorded comparisons, and explains adding one if baseline is included.
As in the source, a proof of the general measure-theoretic distinction between continuity and absolute continuity is not developed; the distinction is stated to avoid a false generalization.
